mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forum_post (user_id, title, content, images, tags) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{images}, #{tags})
mapper.select: SELECT fp.*, u.nickname AS nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_comment WHERE post_id = fp.id) AS comment_count FROM forum_post fp LEFT JOIN user u ON fp.user_id = u.username WHERE fp.id = #{id}

SELECT fp.*, u.nickname AS nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_comment WHERE post_id = fp.id) AS comment_count FROM forum_post fp LEFT JOIN user u ON fp.user_id = u.username ORDER BY fp.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT fp.*, u.nickname AS nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_comment WHERE post_id = fp.id) AS comment_count FROM forum_post fp LEFT JOIN user u ON fp.user_id = u.username WHERE fp.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY fp.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE forum_post SET like_count = like_count + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT fp.*, u.nickname AS nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_comment WHERE post_id = fp.id) AS comment_count FROM forum_post fp LEFT JOIN user u ON fp.user_id = u.username WHERE fp.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tag}, '%') ORDER BY fp.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_post WHERE tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tag}, '%')

SELECT TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(tags, ',', n.n), ',', -1)) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM forum_post JOIN (SELECT 1 n UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5) n ON CHAR_LENGTH(tags) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(tags, ',', '')) >= n.n - 1 WHERE tags IS NOT NULL AND tags != '' GROUP BY name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT fp.*, u.nickname AS nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_comment WHERE post_id = fp.id) AS comment_count, (fp.view_count * 0.4 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_comment WHERE post_id = fp.id) * 0.3 + fp.like_count * 0.2 + COALESCE(fp.favorite_count, 0) * 0.1) AS hot_score FROM forum_post fp LEFT JOIN user u ON fp.user_id = u.username ORDER BY hot_score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
